import 'package:leftover_fixture/registry.dart';
import 'package:test/test.dart';

void main() {
  // In a process that has just started there is nothing to forget: the
  // tests pass with a clearNames() that does nothing.
  setUpAll(clearNames);

  test('registers one', () {
    register('a');
    expect(registered, 1);
  });

  test('registers another', () {
    register('b');
    expect(registered, 2);
  });
}
